# Test m3 with fixed regex
import subprocess
result = subprocess.run(
    ["python", "-c", """
import markdown

# Test 1: Basic header
md = markdown.Markdown(extensions=['toc'])
text = '# Header'
html = md.convert(text)
print("Test 1 - Basic header:")
print(html)
print("toc_tokens:", md.toc_tokens)
print()

# Test 2: Unicode header
md = markdown.Markdown(extensions=['toc'])
text = '# Ünïcödé Héader'
html = md.convert(text)
print("Test 2 - Unicode header:")
print(html)
print("toc_tokens:", md.toc_tokens)
print()

# Test 3: With footnotes
md = markdown.Markdown(extensions=['toc', 'footnotes'])
text = '''# Header[^1]

Some text.

[^1]: Footnote text
'''
html = md.convert(text)
print("Test 3 - With footnotes:")
print(html)
print("toc_tokens:", md.toc_tokens)
"""],
    capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=30
)
print(result.stdout)
if result.stderr:
    print("STDERR:", result.stderr[-2000:])
